review: Set in the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and the surrounding state of Leonida, Grand Theft Auto VI follows dual protagonists Lucia and Jason in Rockstar Games' largest and most immersive open-world crime saga to date.

Continuing the flagship football franchise, EA Sports FC 26 enhances pitch realism with next-gen HyperMotion technology, deeper tactical customization through refined FC IQ systems, and expanded Career Mode features.

Set in the early 1990s during the aftermath of the Cold War, Black Ops 6 features a mind-bending spy thriller campaign, the return of round-based Zombies, and fluid action driven by omnimovement dynamics across all game modes.

God of War Ragnarök is an unforgettable masterpiece that builds brilliantly upon its predecessor. Featuring deep, visceral combat and an emotionally charged narrative following Kratos and Atreus, the game sets a high benchmark for story-driven action-adventures.

Insomniac Games delivers the ultimate superhero experience, letting players seamlessly swap between Peter Parker and Miles Morales. With blazing fast web-swinging, immersive DualSense feedback, and a compelling story involving Venom, it is a flagship title for the PS5.

Baldur's Gate 3 is a monumental achievement in RPG history. Offering unprecedented player choice, memorable companion characters, and tactical turn-based combat, it delivers a rich Dungeons & Dragons adventure that rewards creativity at every turn.

An addictive co-op third-person shooter where galactic warfare meets chaotic friendly fire. Teaming up to spread Managed Democracy against alien bugs and killer automatons delivers unmatched multiplayer action.

Rooted in Chinese mythology and Journey to the West, this action RPG features incredible boss designs, swift martial arts staff combat, and spectacular visual polish that captivates from start to finish.

Jin Sakai's epic samurai journey enhanced for the PS5 with dynamic 4K resolution, 60fps performance, and full DualSense support. The Iki Island expansion adds even more depth to an already magnificent open world.
A masterful modern reimagining of one of the greatest survival horror games ever made. Leon S. Kennedy's rescue mission features modernized controls, elevated tension, and impeccable pacing.

Astro Bot is pure joy distilled into a 3D platformer. Demonstrating creative level design and world-class DualSense haptic feedback, it celebrates PlayStation's rich history while delivering one of the most innovative and charming games on the system.

Aloy journeys across a majestic post-apocalyptic frontier in a stunning open-world adventure. Featuring improved tactical machine combat, vibrant underwater exploration, and a engrossing sci-fi mystery.

Expanding the legendary journey beyond Midgar, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth offers a breathtaking open world, refined synergy-based action combat, and an emotionally resonant story filled with minigames and deep character interactions.

Completely overhauled with Update 2.0 and the spy-thriller expansion Phantom Liberty, Night City stands as a dazzling, immersive sci-fi sandbox filled with memorable quests and deep RPG customization.

gameName: The Last of Us Part I
review: Rebuilt from the ground up for PS5 using Naughty Dog's latest engine, Joel and Ellie's heartbreaking survival journey feels more intimate, realistic, and emotionally impactful than ever before.
A dark high-fantasy action RPG filled with political intrigue and monumental Eikon battles. Clive Rosfield's tale delivers jaw-dropping cinematic spectacle and stylish real-time combat.
The premier sim racer for automotive enthusiasts. Featuring hundreds of meticulously detailed cars, realistic physics, and incredible DualSense haptic trigger integration for feeling every tire slip.
A technological marvel that fully leverages the PS5's high-speed SSD. Jump through dimensional rifts instantly in this vibrant action platformer filled with explosive weaponry, humor, and heart.

A breathtaking remake of the classic dark fantasy RPG that launched the Soulslike phenomenon. Featuring gorgeous visuals, oppressive atmospheres, and unforgiving gameplay, it remains an essential PS5 showcase title.

A relentless psychological horror roguelike shooter that blends fast bullet-hell chaos with haunting narrative storytelling. Selene's endless loop on the alien world of Atropos is thrilling and immensely satisfying to master.
A psychological survival horror masterpiece that blends mind-bending narrative structure, surreal live-action sequences, and terrifying gameplay into an unforgettable artistic experience.

A stylish high-octane action game set in a desolate sci-fi Earth. Combining precise parry-heavy combat with a pulsing soundtrack and intense boss battles, it delivers a thrilling ride from start to finish.

An immersive single-player, narrative-driven action RPG that challenges players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, and how to approach dynamic monster encounters.
Powered by Unreal Engine 5, Tekken 8 pushes the limits of fighting games with thrilling visceral battles, high-fidelity character models, and the aggressive new Heat System.
Step into the shoes of a transfer student thrust into an unexpected fate when entering the hour hidden between one day and the next. A mesmerizing remake with modernized visuals and gameplay.
The first new universe in over 25 years from Bethesda. Create any character you want and explore with unprecedented freedom as you embark on an epic journey to answer humanity's greatest mystery.

Powered by Capcom’s proprietary RE ENGINE, Street Fighter 6 spans three distinct game modes: World Tour, Fighting Ground, and Battle Hub, revolutionizing the fighting genre for beginners and pros alike.
A thrilling soulslike that adapts the story of Pinocchio, setting it against the dark background of the Belle Époque era in Krat. Face terrifying puppets with adaptable weapon combinations.
The sci-fi survival-horror classic returns, completely rebuilt from the ground up to offer a deeper and more immersive experience with stunning visual fidelity and suspenseful atmospheric audio.

gameName: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon
review: A high-octane mech action game combining FromSoftware's long-standing expertise in mech games with their signature action gameplay. Customize your Armored Core to face massive bosses in fast-paced 3D assembly combat.

gameName: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
review: An epic adventure across the land and skies of Hyrule. Create your own path through the landscapes with new abilities like Ultrahand and Fuse in this masterclass of sandbox design.
Classic Mario side-scrolling gameplay is turned on its head with the addition of Wonder Flowers. These game-changing items trigger spectacular moments you have to see to believe.
Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this spellbinding rogue-like dungeon crawler sequel from Supergiant Games.
Fight, farm, build, and work alongside mysterious creatures called 'Pals' in this completely open-world multiplayer survival and crafting experience.
Having received a letter from his deceased wife, James heads to where they shared so many memories in Silent Hill. Rebuilt with cutting-edge ray-tracing visuals and modern third-person camera.
From the creators of Persona 3, 4, and 5 comes a high-fantasy RPG world where your protagonist will journey alongside his fairy partner, Gallica, to lift the curse from the kingdom’s lost prince.

Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine. Unleash deadly abilities and an arsenal of devastating weaponry to wipe out the relentless Tyranid hordes in spectacular third-person action.
A thrilling story-driven action RPG set amidst the chaos of a 15th Century civil war in Bohemia. Dive into a massive, realistic medieval world with deep combat and historical authenticity.
The unbridled force of wild nature runs wild and relentless, with environments dynamically transforming from moment to moment. Experience an unprecedented evolution of hunting action.
Hideo Kojima's mind-bending vision continues. Sam Porter Bridges embarks on a new journey beyond the United Cities of America to save humanity from extinction across vast, surreal landscapes.
